# Reviewed dependencies

Pinned public Core and SDK archives enable independent clean-checkout installation.
`core-receipt.json` and `sdk-receipt.json` record base source commits, explicit dirty
working-tree provenance inventories and exact SHA-256. Current artifacts share
IfSoul 0.3.0. No private composition, user data or credentials are included.
No npm registry publication is implied. Historical archive copies are preserved
outside the public checkout in local release evidence rather than active pins.
